description: This file defines multiple mixins related to gradient backgrounds, including linear and radial gradient styles for use in stylesheets.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: Applies a background color or gradient if gradients are enabled.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient from left to right between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient from top to bottom between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified angle between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient with three colors.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient with three colors.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped gradient pattern at a specified angle.
